subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should ClawHub accept package release changelog auto-preview for authorized package publishers and staff, including use of prior release README content for preview generation?
rationale: Code review can verify the access gate, but a non-maintainer PR is adding a new public action that reads package release storage and may call OpenAI, which is a product/security boundary choice.

options.title: Accept gated auto-preview
options.body: Land the owner/publisher/staff-gated preview path with the current regression coverage and proof.

options.title: Narrow the access contract
options.body: Require a stricter manage-only role or explicit maintainer-approved policy before reading prior release storage.

options.title: Keep changelogs manual-only
options.body: Close or pause this PR if automatic plugin release changelog previews are not desired.

recommendation.title: Accept gated auto-preview
recommendation.body: Land the owner/publisher/staff-gated preview path with the current regression coverage and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is both a requested reviewer and the strongest current-main history owner for the affected plugin publish/package backend surfaces.
